unconfirmed.text: Hersheypark says save up to $105 on 2027 season passes. Prices include tax. Everyone aged 3+ needs a pass; kids 2 and under free. Per person: Full Size $189 (shown next to $250), Bite Size $159 ($195), King Size $249 ($300), Giant Size $385 ($490). Family of 4, all aged 3+: four Full Size passes $756 vs $1,000, so about $244 (24%) less. Our estimate. With a child 2 or under (free): three Full Size passes, $567 vs $750. Our estimate. Why it isn't priced as a deal: $250 is Hersheypark's own shown price, and we haven't compared passes with summer day tickets. Full, King and Giant also get unlimited Christmas Candylane visits for the rest of 2026, plus free parking. Bite Size gets 50% off parking bought ahead online. Valid through Jan 2, 2028. Non-refundable. Holiday-only visit: a Christmas Candylane Family 4-Pack (parking included) is $99.95 plus a $4.95 fee and tax. No end date stated.
